_meta.explored_as: Thomas Claver (admin, his own approver – his requests are auto-approved)
_meta.explored_viewport: 1456x868 CSS px (BrowserOS window, DPR 2; could not be resized to 1920x1080)
_meta.selector_rules: Plain CSS or CSS:text-is("…"). Every action selector resolved to count 1 / visible 1 with scripts/explorer-kit/resolve.js at the moment it is used (unless a note says otherwise). The recorder uses locator(sel).first() plus scrollIntoViewIfNeeded, so elements below the fold are fine.
_meta.format: Each fragment: pre (state the fragment expects), actions (recipe action format), expect (suggested step post-condition), creates_data (true = writes to pre-prod), notes. Stitch fragments into recipe steps; split long fragments into several steps as narration needs.
_meta.replay_check: 2026-10-01: every fragment except the two creates_data fragments was replayed in order in a fresh tab with real mouse clicks at the resolved element centre: every action selector resolved count 1 / visible 1 and every expect matched in < 120 ms. new_type_save and new_absence_note_and_submit ran once during exploration (that is the data listed in the UI map) and were not replayed. new_absence_dates_nov_9_11 replays to the expected collision because the Nov 9–11 absence now exists.

ui_language_to_czech.pre: Any app page, UI in another language. Only needed if the recording profile is not Czech yet. Preferred: set localStorage key local-translate=cs in the storage state instead of clicking.
ui_language_to_czech.notes: Flag dropdown top right (header, slnk-common-translate-bar). Options are flag-only nb-options (no text); English = .fi-gb, Czech = .fi-cz. The choice is stored in localStorage 'local-translate' (value 'cs' / 'en'), so it survives reloads and is shared by every tab of this browser profile.

new_absence_dates_nov_9_11.pre: Type chosen. Recording runs in OCTOBER 2026 (the datepicker opens on the current month; in November drop the two next-month clicks).
new_absence_dates_nov_9_11.notes: Od/Do are readonly (format '9. 11. 2026'). Picking Od also sets Do to the same day. The Do picker opens on the month of Od (no second next-month click); the Od picker disables days after Do. 'Kontrola události' then shows Počet dní 3 / Čerpání fondu 3 Dny (+ check icon). Collision → nb-dialog-container .p-message-text 'V těchto dnech je kolize s jinou událostí: 09.11.2026, 10.11.2026, 11.11.2026', no check icon, Vytvořit disabled. Nov 9–11 2026 are now TAKEN by the exploration absence (replay hit exactly that collision). Nov 23–25 2026 (Mon–Wed) were checked free (green check, 3 Dny) and NOT created – use day numbers 23 and 25 and the expect '23.11.2026 - 25.11.2026, 3 Dny' for the real recording. Re-picking Od in an already filled dialog failed once (click landed while the picker was opening) – always run this fragment on a fresh dialog.
